rubric_items.reason: Selection, boundary, closed statuses, list agreement, POST/PATCH, 404 and the web line, link, empty state and local date are tested. REQ-10 (one clock read per request, CO-2) has no test, although ut.md lists one.

Most assertions check observable results (toEqual on {id, starts_at, doctor_name}, href, textContent). A few are weaker: toMatchObject on id only, and toContain for the doctor name with no check of order.

The exactly-now boundary, already-started, all-started null, Cancelled/Completed/No-show, the local vs UTC date, no appointments and 404 are covered. The only-Cancelled-upcoming → null case (S-2 AC4) is not tested at the API.

API tests use Vitest+Supertest on a fresh PG with a fixed clock in api/test. Web tests use jsdom and Testing Library in web/src/__tests__. Names start with HMS-15 REQ-n/EP-n, as existing repo tests do.
No test counts or coverage numbers are given. The artifact defers to the verifier and says coverage is skipped, which matches checks.json (coverage exit 78, skip).
